objective: Final predicted target affinity first; valid high-tail paths and strain reported separately
coordinate_support: Read from evidence and program; currently 0 to 0.5. Complete native inference to 1

rounds.1: Paired historical incumbent and native controls on a fresh screen batch
rounds.2: Add dynamic positive versus observed-rest regional contrast at weight 0.05; preserve all incumbent control parameters
rounds.3: Increase only regional scalar weight to 0.15
rounds.4: Increase only regional scalar weight to 0.40
rounds.5: Replace observed-rest controls with a 0.75 spatial-hard mixture; retain best tested dose
rounds.6: Increase only score ambiguity margin from 0.10 to 0.20 weighted IQR
rounds.7: Test regional positive attraction instead of background repulsion from the best tested parent
rounds.8: Freeze candidate before seeing confirmation labels; paired historical incumbent and native on batches 37,38
rounds.9: Frozen candidate on the same batches 37,38
rounds.10: Frozen candidate and native on fresh batches 39,40

selection_rule: Among rounds 2-7 with validity and PB-fast at least 0.90, maximize all-attempt mean pIC50; then valid p95, distinct qualified elites and lower median strain. If no admissible candidate, confirm the best mean candidate as a failed exploratory proposal, never replace the incumbent automatically.
statistics_unit: Generation batch, not copies or time nodes; one-batch screen has no inferential confidence interval

execution.chemical_graph_policy: Free native changes; no chemical identity or pair-distance gate
execution.remote_role: Inference and cryptographically verified transport only; scientific analysis local
execution.retention: Local evidence, declarative rationale, code commits and reports. Clean previous generated data before the next round; preserve original Steer and checkpoints.
